package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const (
	// SubjectLearningActionClosed is the student-owned trigger consumed by the teacher service.
	SubjectLearningActionClosed = "learning_action.closed"
	// LearningActionClosedSchemaVersion is the supported student event schema.
	LearningActionClosedSchemaVersion = 1
)

// LearningActionClosed is the normalized student-owned trigger for finalizing
// teacher assistance. It intentionally contains no outcome, score, or mastery.
type LearningActionClosed struct {
	EventID          string
	StudentID        string
	CorrelationID    string
	CausationID      string
	LearningActionID string
	ContextType      LearningContextType
	ContextID        string
	LearningTargets  []LearningTargetRef
	OccurredAt       time.Time
}

// NewLearningActionClosed validates and normalizes the consumed v1 contract.
func NewLearningActionClosed(input LearningActionClosed) (LearningActionClosed, error) {
	input.EventID = strings.TrimSpace(input.EventID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.CorrelationID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CorrelationID)
	input.CausationID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CausationID)
	input.LearningActionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningActionID)
	input.ContextID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ContextID)
	input.OccurredAt = input.OccurredAt.UTC()

	if !validUUID(input.EventID) || !validUUID(input.StudentID) ||
		!validUUID(input.CorrelationID) || !validUUID(input.CausationID) ||
		!validUUID(input.LearningActionID) || input.CorrelationID != input.LearningActionID ||
		!validClosedActionContextType(input.ContextType) || !validUUID(input.ContextID) ||
		input.OccurredAt.IsZero() {
		return LearningActionClosed{}, errors.New("invalid learning action closure")
	}

	targets, err := normalizeLearningTargetRefs(input.LearningTargets, 100)
	if err != nil {
		return LearningActionClosed{}, err
	}
	input.LearningTargets = targets
	return input, nil
}

func normalizeLearningTargetRefs(targets []LearningTargetRef, maximum int) ([]LearningTargetRef, error) {
	if len(targets) > maximum {
		return nil, errors.New("too many learning targets")
	}
	normalized := make([]LearningTargetRef, len(targets))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(targets))
	for index, target := range targets {
		target.Key = strings.TrimSpace(target.Key)
		target.Version = strings.TrimSpace(target.Version)
		if !validLearningTargetType(target.Type) || !validValue(target.Key, 255) || len(target.Version) > 128 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid learning target at index %d", index)
		}
		key := string(target.Type) + "\x00" + target.Key + "\x00" + target.Version
		if _, exists := seen[key]; exists {
			return nil, errors.New("duplicate learning target")
		}
		seen[key] = struct{}{}
		normalized[index] = target
	}
	return normalized, nil
}

func validClosedActionContextType(value LearningContextType) bool {
	switch value {
	case LearningContextLessonTask, LearningContextPracticeTask, LearningContextProject:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}
